UserBackup.title: UserBackup
UserBackup.description: Cloud-synced backup of a user's EPI Keep Notes, DOB history, custom sub-block center names, and annual microplan date overrides.

ownerId.description: Authenticated Firebase UID of the backup owner.

notes.description: List of user Keep-style notes (up to 200 items).

history.description: List of saved child DOB calculation history items (up to 100 items).

centerNames.description: Map of sub-block code to custom center name & address.

overrides.description: Map of year key (epi_overrides_YYYY) to manual session date overrides.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the last cloud sync update.

/epi_users_backup/{userId}.description: Per-user private cloud backup document keyed by Firebase Auth UID.
